method: DuckDB aggregations on parquet; plots from SQL histograms or 250k samples; no pandas load of 21.9M reviews

outliers.methodology: Percentile and rule-based EDA tags only; not fraud labels. IQR on reviewer review_count also counted.

candidate_label.status: heuristic candidate suspicious-review label; NOT verified fraud ground truth

leakage_warnings: TARGET LEAKAGE RISK: bfr_* vs Track 2 candidate_label
class/rating_polarity is a recode of overall
deviations include the current row in group means

A.name: review_length_chars / review_length_words
A.why: Supported by source text; varies by rating; usable for NLP/length risk without being a recode of the target.

A.name: helpful_votes / helpful_ratio
A.why: Observed engagement; biased by exposure but not a recode of class/label.

A.name: reviewer review_count, unique_products, reviews_per_active_day
A.why: Directly computed activity/diversity; useful for unsupervised risk profiling. Not fraud GT.

A.name: five_star_ratio, one_star_ratio, rating_entropy, extreme_rating_ratio
A.why: Describe rating concentration; interpretable. Handle n=1 separately.

A.name: product review_count, unique_reviewers, five_star_ratio, review_velocity
A.why: Product-level volume and concentration for later product trust scoring.

A.name: is_exact_duplicate_text / exact_text_copy_count
A.why: Template/copy signal; hash-limited; not a label.

B.name: product_rating_deviation, reviewer_rating_deviation
B.why: Useful outlier signal but include the current row in the mean; consider leave-one-out before supervised use.

B.name: avg_reviewer_rating_variability on products
B.why: AVG skips NULL std (single-review reviewers omitted).

B.name: review_year / month / day_of_week
B.why: Calendar effects; not time-of-day. Check drift before using in a classifier.

B.name: Track 2 candidate_label as target
B.why: Only possible rare-event target; unverified; split by reviewerID if used.

C.name: rating_variance vs rating_std
C.why: Variance is std squared (Pearson ~1 when both non-null).

C.name: review_length_words vs review_length_chars
C.why: Both measure length; likely high correlation.

C.name: unique_reviewers vs review_count on products
C.why: Often nearly 1:1 if few repeat reviewers per product.

D.name: bfr_* predicting Track 2 candidate_label
D.why: TARGET LEAKAGE RISK: large mean gaps vs label; likely used to construct or is collinear with the heuristic.

D.name: candidate_label as a Track 1 feature
D.why: Different corpus; would leak if used both as feature and target.

E.name: review_hour
E.why: Midnight UTC stored; hour=5 in IST for all rows; not genuine time-of-day.

E.name: IDs (review_id, reviewerID, asin) as numeric model features
